title: KinoControl
description: A Glass-to-plugin control message of Kino, version 1, published on `geldar.<shard>.kino.control` (decision 0075). Glass asks the plugin to start or stop reading one agent for the feed. The plugin only reads: a start adds nothing the agent can see (no chat, entity or packet). `start` is sent when the first pane watches an agent, `resync` when a later pane joins (the plugin sends the window again), `refresh` as a heartbeat while any pane watches (a plugin that hears no refresh for a while stops the target, which covers a Glass restart), `stop` after the last pane leaves. While the plugin kill switch is off it ignores every message.
